en.t: As soon as she finished writing it, she crossed it out.

units.source_text: 匂亲王看到“两不着”三字，表示不快。

en.t: When Prince Niou saw the three words "caught between both sides," he showed his displeasure.

units.source_text: 浮舟一想，写这三字的确失策，羞耻之余，把纸撕破了。

en.t: Ukifune thought about it and realized that writing those three words had indeed been a mistake; overcome with shame, she tore the paper apart.

units.source_text: 匂亲王的丰姿本来是令人百看不厌的，此时更加深深地感动了浮舟的心。

en.t: Prince Niou's graceful beauty was always something one could look at forever without tiring, and now it moved Ukifune's heart even more deeply.

units.source_text: 他对浮舟说尽千言万语，其风度之优美不可言喻。

en.t: He poured out countless words to Ukifune, and the elegance of his bearing was beyond description.
